summary: Petition under Section 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking approval for creation of security interest over the assets of Navinal Transmission Limited in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited for the benefit of Power Finance Corporation Limited (including its Assignees, Transferees, Novatees) in respect of the Network Expansion Scheme in Navinal (Mundra) area of Gujarat for drawl of power in the area. _(b) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over all assets including all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender / Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed / to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novates and substitutes thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by executing deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, Indenture of Mortgage, Mortgage by deposit of title deeds and such other security documents as per law or as may be required by the Lender from time to time through which a charge can be created._ _(c) Pass any or such further orders as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ _b. a first charge by way of hypothecation, on all the Petitioner’s movable properties and assets, including plant and machinery, machinery spares, equipment, tools and accessories, furniture, fixtures, vehicles, encumbrance (first charge) over the assets of the Project as permitted under TSA and all other movable assets wherever situated, both present and future;_ _c. a first charge on all the Petitioner’s Current Assets, including but not limited to, book debts, operating cash flows, uncalled capital, receivables, commissions, revenue of whatsoever nature and wherever arising, both present and future;_ _d. a first charge over all accounts of the Petitioner, including, the Trust and Retention Account and the Sub-Account(s), (including Debt Service Reserve Account of 1 (one) quarter of principal and interest payment (DSRA) or any account created for any reserve(s) to be created and maintained (or any account in substitution thereof) that may be opened in accordance with the Trust and Retention Account Agreement and the Financing Documents, or any of the other Project Documents and all funds from time to time deposited therein, the Receivables and all Permitted Investments or other securities representing all amounts credited to the Trust and Retention Account, any letter of credit and other reserves and any other bank accounts of the Petitioner present and future wherever maintained;_ _e. assignment in favour of the Lender, on the following, relating to the Project/ Petitioner:_ - _ii. all the rights, titles, benefits, claims, demands and interest of the Petitioner in, to and under all the Clearances related to the Project (and shall include amendments or modifications to such Clearances, if any);_ - _iv. all the rights, titles, interests, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Petitioner under all Insurance Contracts (and shall include amendments or modifications to such Insurance Contracts, if any) and Insurance Proceeds;_ - _vi. all intangible assets of the Petitioner, including but not limited to goodwill, intellectual property rights, undertaking, present and future, in a form and manner acceptable to the Lender.”_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, as per Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, it is entitled to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables or the Transmission Project Assets in favour of the lender(s) or lenders’ representative (as defined in the TSA) as security for amounts payable under the Financing Agreements. Therefore, the Petitioner has submitted that it has the full right to create a security interest and charge in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited for the benefit of the lender, subject to conditions prescribed under Article 15 of the TSA. 7. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Act seeking prior approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security Interest over the assets including the movable and immovable assets for the Project in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender and for its subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage to secure the total commitment of the lender aggregating to Rs.2,028.00 crore. 8. The Petitioner has also relied on the Commission’s order dated 14.8.2025 in Petition No. 586/MP/2025 _,_ wherein the Commission granted in-principle approval and was allowed to create a security interest over the assets of the Transmission Project. 9. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 24.4.2026 after notice to the Respondents. _Vide_ Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 24.2.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. The Commission directed Respondent No. 1, CTUIL, to clarify the compliance status of directions issued at paragraph 32 of the order dated 19.11.2025 passed in Petition No. 426/TL/2024. 10. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Respondent No. 1, CTUIL, also failed to furnish the information called for vide last ROP dated 24.2.2026. Upon consideration of the Petitioner’s submissions, the matter was reserved for order. _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._
